decks.notes: The focus of this deck is to rapidly deploy aggressive creatures and burn spells to apply pressure on the opponent and quickly reduce their life total to zero. By utilizing a mix of low-cost creatures with high power and efficient burn spells, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize or mount a defense. The inclusion of cards like Soulstone Sanctuary and Monstrous Rage provide additional support to keep the pressure on and ensure a swift victory through aggressive tactics and direct damage.

This deck focuses on aggressively overwhelming the opponent with fast and efficient creatures and burn spells. Utilizing a low mana curve and a mix of creatures with haste and direct damage spells, the goal is to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to zero before they can stabilize. The deck includes cards that can provide additional damage and protection for key creatures, allowing for multiple avenues of attack and ensuring constant pressure on the opponent.

The key concept of this deck is to establish early board presence and disrupt the opponent's strategy with a mix of removal spells and hand disruption, while maintaining card advantage with cards like Proft's Eidetic Memory. By combining aggressive creatures like Kitsa, Otterball Elite and Steamcore Scholar with powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and close out the game before they can recover. The mana base is designed to support both black and blue spells effectively for a balanced aggressive strategy.

The deck focuses on creating a fast-paced, aggressive strategy using a combination of low-cost creatures and disruption spells. By overwhelming the opponent with a steady stream of threats and disrupting their game plan with cards like Temporary Lockdown and Get Lost, the deck aims to maintain control of the battlefield and quickly close out the game. Additionally, the deck includes powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Loran of the Third Path to ensure a strong late-game presence.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells, dealing damage as efficiently as possible. It aims to establish a strong board presence early on by playing creatures like Emberheart Challenger and Magebane Lizard, while also utilizing burn spells like Burst Lightning and Scorching Shot to remove any threats the opponent may have. The deck is designed to be fast-paced and deliver consistent damage, ultimately ending the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and spells in a Blue-Red color scheme. By using low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Drake Hatcher, along with efficient spells like Sleight of Hand and Stock Up, the deck aims to quickly build a board presence and deal damage to the opponent. Additional support from cards like Into the Flood Maw and Torch the Tower provide removal options and added value. Overall, the goal is to maintain pressure and win the game as quickly as possible with a flurry of spells and creatures.

The main focus of this UW Control deck is to control the board and disrupt your opponent's strategies through counterspells, removal spells, and bounce effects. By using a combination of versatile spells like Negate and Day of Judgment, along with powerful planeswalkers like Jace, the Perfected Mind, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent. The deck also utilizes creatures with evasion like Marang River Regent to apply pressure and close out the game efficiently. With a mix of interactive spells and efficient threats, this deck aims to dominate the late game and secure victory.

The main concept of the deck is to control the game by using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, board wipes, and card draw to slow down the opponent's plays and establish dominance on the battlefield. The deck focuses on efficiently managing resources and disrupting the opponent's strategy while building up its own board presence with powerful creatures like Marang River Regent and Beza, the Bounding Spring. With a mix of control elements and threats, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and secure victory through card advantage and strong board presence.

With a heavy emphasis on early game pressure and board presence, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. Cards like Burst Lightning, Emberheart Challenger, and Monstrous Rage help push damage through while cards like Magebane Lizard and Witchstalker Frenzy provide additional threats to keep the pressure on. This deck focuses on aggressive play with a combination of low-cost creatures and cards that disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck includes cards that generate tokens, provide extra mana, and lock down opponent's options. The overall strategy is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a mix of creature aggression and disruption, utilizing a combination of white and black cards for maximum efficiency. The deck aims to create a fast-paced game that puts pressure on the opponent and limits their ability to react effectively.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly ramp up damage and overwhelm the opponent with a mix of powerful creatures and burn spells. With cards like Lightning Helix and Burst Lightning for direct damage, along with creatures like Magebane Lizard and Voice of Victory for continuous pressure, the deck aims to keep up the aggression and close out the game swiftly. Elspeth, Storm Slayer and Bruse Tarl, Roving Rancher provide additional support and utility, while Sheltered by Ghosts and Screaming Nemesis offer protection and resilience. Overall, the deck aims to be aggressive and proactive in securing victories.

This deck focuses on using control spells to gain the upper hand in combat by effectively managing the opponent's resources and strategies. It includes cards that disrupt opponent's plans, remove threats from the board, and provide protection for your own creatures. The deck also includes a mix of creatures with different abilities that can further support the control strategy or put pressure on the opponent. Overall, the goal is to outmaneuver and outlast the opponent through strategic decision-making and resource management.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the Omniscience card to cast multiple spells for free, creating a powerful combo that can overwhelm the opponent. Cards like Roiling Dragonstorm and Marang River Regent are used to take advantage of this combo by dealing damage to the opponent. Other cards like Stock Up and Meticulous Archive are included to help find key cards and keep the combo going. The deck also includes protection cards like Temporary Lockdown to keep the opponent at bay while setting up the combo.

The deck focuses on utilizing cheap aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Cori-Steel Cutter, alongside pump spells like Monstrous Rage and Stock Up, to quickly overwhelm opponents with high burst damage. The inclusion of cards like Into the Flood Maw and Riverpyre Verge provide additional ways to push damage through and maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck also incorporates card draw and selection spells like Sleight of Hand and Opt to maintain consistency and keep the aggression going. The mana base is optimized for quick casting and flexibility.

This Golgari Aggro deck relies on a combination of aggressive creature plays and removal spells to quickly overpower opponents. The deck features a mix of creatures with strong attack power, like Mosswood Dreadknight and Sentinel of the Nameless City, supported by removal spells such as Go for the Throat and Maelstrom Pulse. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Duress and Gix's Command to disrupt opponents' strategies. Overall, the deck focuses on a fast-paced, aggressive playstyle to dominate the battlefield and control the game.

This deck revolves around using Omniscience to cast spells for free, focusing on the Omniscience combo and utilizing cards that can help maintain control of the board or generate card advantage. The key strategy involves setting up the combo pieces, such as Roiling Dragonstorm and Marang River Regent, while using cards like Stock Up and Meticulous Archive to draw into the combo pieces efficiently. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Temporary Lockdown and Founding the Third Path to control the opponent's board, allowing for a smooth execution of the combo.
